text.az:
Amma bilirsən, bu sarayın maraqlı tərəfi təkcə hökmdarların yaşayışı deyil.
Burada həm də məscid, hamam, türbələr və su anbarı olub.
Yəni saray öz daxilində kiçik bir dünya kimi idi.
text.en:
Let's go down a little, to the lower courtyard.
Here is the tomb of the Shirvanshahs. Shah Khalilullah I built it in 1435 for his family: his mother and his young son.
Think about that for a second. One of the most powerful men of his time, building a quiet stone room for the people he loved most.
Look up at its portal. Tall, carved, proud. But inside, it's simple and still.
